summary: Playbooks orchestrate infrastructure with fine control over how many machines run at once, as in a simple example using serial: 5 and roles.
questions: How do I update only five servers at a time in a playbook?
What does a simple playbook with roles look like?

answer_card.title: Playbooks overview
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  serial: 5  # update 5 machines at a time
  roles:
  - common
  - webapp
- hosts: content_servers
  roles:
  - common
  - content
```
